questionText: May I take you out for a cup of coffee?

coffeeLocation.note: Cozy fireplace seating & fresh hand-poured coffee! ☕✨

slides.title: Hey there...
slides.subtitle: A small note crafted just for you
slides.content: I wanted to share something that has been on my mind for a while now. Life gets wonderfully busy, but certain people always manage to stand out in the brightest way.
slides.quote: "The best things in life are even better when shared."

slides.title: Moments That Matter
slides.subtitle: Simple joys and genuine conversations
slides.content: Every time we talk, I find myself admiring your kindness, your sense of humor, and how effortlessly comfortable it feels to be around you.
slides.quote: "A warm conversation can make an entire week feel special."

slides.title: No Pressure, Just Warmth
slides.subtitle: A genuine invitation
slides.content: I cherish our connection and wanted to create a quiet, relaxed moment for us—a chance to step away from the daily rush, sip something warm, and catch up properly.

slides.title: So, Here Is My Question...
slides.subtitle: A simple step forward
slides.content: I would love the opportunity to share a cozy coffee date with you. No rush, no expectations, just good coffee and great company.
slides.quote: "Shall we create a new favorite memory?"
